title: Delete Your Ledg Data
description: You can request deletion of your Ledg account and the personal data associated with it. This page explains how to make a request and what happens afterward.

sections.heading: How to Request Data Deletion
body: To request deletion of your Ledg account and associated application data, send an email to the address below using the email address associated with your Ledg account.
bullets: Send the request from the same email address associated with your Ledg account so we can verify that the request belongs to you

sections.heading: What Happens After You Request
body: After we receive your request, we may first verify your account to make sure the request is coming from the account owner.
Once the request has been verified, we will process the deletion and let you know when it has been completed.
bullets: Verify the request and identify the associated Ledg account
Delete the Ledg application data associated with your account
Handle associated authentication data through Clerk where applicable
Notify you when the deletion process is completed

sections.heading: What Gets Deleted
body: When your account deletion request is completed, we will delete the Ledg data associated with your account, including:

sections.heading: Exceptions
body: Some limited information may need to be retained for a reasonable period if required by law, needed for security or fraud prevention, or stored in backups that have not yet been overwritten.
Any information retained for these reasons will not be used for normal Ledg functionality after your account has been deleted.
